Company: GROUPSOFT US Inc.  


Location: Hyderabad, India  


Employment Type: Full\-time  


Industry: Retail

implementation and IT consulting solutions. Our team of experienced consultants and experts  


deliver powerful, sustainable SAP solutions that drive business success.  


We are a knowledge\-driven company, and we strongly believe our strength lies in our team.  


Our workplace environment is aimed to be team and learning\-orientated, conducive to

Groupsoft has offices in Princeton USA, Toronto Canada, Pune \& Hyderabad\- India

Considering SAP products/solutions are always evolving, new versions and technologies

The consultants need to be on top of the learning curve and keep on building new skills in

Groupsoft provides SAP Learning hub access as well as also provide ongoing training and

title: I&P-GN-SC&E--Manager- VCR-Digital Thread
description:
Find endless opportunities to solve our clients' toughest challenges, as you work with exceptional people, the latest tech, and leading companies across industries.

**Business Unit:** Strategy\&Consulting, Global Network I **Areas of Work:** Digital Thread and Connected Twins\| **Level:** Manager\| **Location:** Gurugram, Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad \| **Overall Relevant Exp:** 7\+ years

**The Practice\- A Brief Sketch:**


Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture Supply Chain Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept\-to\-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.


You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision\-making.

**Digital Thread**

**Digital Thread** focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept\-to\-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real\-time, data\-driven decision making.

* Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems.
* Digital Thread use cases involving connected BOMs, product traceability, engineering change management, configuration management, quality visibility and concept\-to\-service process integration.
* Current\-state assessments and future\-state operating model design that improve end\-to\-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision\-making across the value chain.

**Connected Twins**

**Connected Twins** build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.

* Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end\-to\-end supply chains.
* Simulation\-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment.
* Process architecture and future\-state workflow design using process simulators, AI copilots, agentic decision\-support frameworks and digital representations of physical operations in collaboration with senior business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Digital Thread and Connected Twin transformation programs from strategy through execution across product development, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions
* Develop business cases, transformation roadmaps and investment strategies for clients seeking to improve traceability, visibility, operational resilience and decision intelligence
* Shape Digital Thread strategies across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM, APS and supply chain ecosystems to improve product lifecycle visibility and concept\-to\-service integration
* Define Connected Twin strategies and use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, logistics networks, facilities and end\-to\-end supply chains
* Lead executive workshops and client discussions focused on value realization, operating model transformation, AI readiness, simulation capabilities and supply chain resilience
* Drive process architecture, future\-state operating models and enterprise decision\-support frameworks enabled by Digital Thread, Connected Twins and GenAI
* Lead scenario simulation initiatives involving network optimization, disruption analysis, inventory strategies, manufacturing performance, quality improvement and supply chain risk assessment
* Define GenAI\-enabled decision intelligence capabilities, agentic workflows and AI copilots that support operational planning and business decision making
* Contribute to pre\-sales activities including opportunity qualification, client presentations, solution development, proposal creation and business case development
* Develop industry\-specific offerings, consulting methodologies, reusable assets, accelerators and thought leadership related to Digital Thread and Connected Twins
* Partner with Industry X, Data \& AI, Supply Chain, Engineering and Technology teams to develop integrated client solutions
* Build and mentor high\-performing consulting teams while supporting capability development, knowledge management and career growth

  

**Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role**

* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain and concept\-to\-service business processes
* Strong strategy and transformation consulting capabilities with experience leading complex client engagements
* Ability to connect Digital Thread, Connected Twins, GenAI and data\-driven decision making to measurable business outcomes
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills with demonstrated business impact
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Strong storytelling capabilities and ability to communicate complex technology concepts in business terms
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams comprising consultants, data scientists, engineers, architects and product specialists
* Strong program management, governance and risk management skills
* Ability to manage multiple client workstreams while maintaining delivery quality and commercial performance
* Strong people leadership, coaching and team\-development capabilities

**Your experience counts!**

* MBA from a tier 1 institute with work experience in consulting or related fields preferred
* 7\+ years of Hands\-on experience developing digital twin or simulation\-based prototypes to model physical products, assets, operations or supply networks, enabling scenario analysis, disruption testing and performance optimization
* 
* Proven experience leading transformation programs involving Digital Thread, Digital Twins, Connected Twins, process intelligence, GenAI or enterprise\-wide business transformation initiatives
* Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, manufacturing operations, supply chain planning, logistics, quality management and service operations
* Experience with Digital Thread ecosystems spanning PLM, ERP, MES, CRM, APS, product structures, connected BOMs, configuration management and engineering change processes
* Experience leading initiatives involving supply chain visibility, control towers, decision intelligence, simulation, scenario planning, network modelling or operational resilience
* Practical experience with GenAI, agentic workflows, AI copilots, prompt engineering and enterprise AI transformation initiatives
* Experience working with process discovery and process mining platforms such as Celonis, Signavio or Power Automate Process Mining
* Exposure to industrial IoT, connected operations, digital manufacturing, Industry 4\.0 or smart operations programs is highly desirable
* Experience owning client relationships, leading workstreams, managing teams and supporting business development activities
* Industry experience in Manufacturing, Automotive, Aerospace \& Defense, Consumer Goods, Retail, Life Sciences, High Tech, Energy, Utilities, Telecom, Oil \& Gas or BFSI is desirable
* Experience implementing responsible AI, governance and risk management frameworks for enterprise AI deployments

**Job Summary**
---------------


We at HCLTech seek to recruit experienced PreSales Architects to join our Hybrid Cloud Business Unit. In this role, you will join a skilled team of Solution Architects whose primary responsibility is to support our sales teams in developing best\-in\-class and innovative technology\-centric solutions across the Data Center and Cloud portfolio. We are looking for candidates with proven experience in responding to RFP / RFIs, solution creation, client interactions and presentations, pricing, business case analysis, and deal lifecycle management.

  

Key expertise should include managed services, servers/storage/backup modernization, hyper\-converged infrastructure, software\-defined DC, private/public cloud automation, cloud assessment, cloud migration and transformation, cloud operations, FinOps, and a good understanding of PaaS and containers.

------------------------

title: Presales Executive
description:
HCMX Global Education is looking for enthusiastic and target\-driven Tele Sales Executives to join our growing admissions team.

The candidate will be responsible for connecting with prospective students, explaining our programs, generating interest, and converting leads into admissions.

If you have excellent communication skills, enjoy speaking with people, and are passionate about sales, we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

* Make outbound calls to prospective students .
* Explain our programs, eligibility criteria, fee structures, and scholarship opportunities.
* Understand student requirements and guide them toward suitable programs.
* Follow up with interested students through calls and WhatsApp.
* Schedule counselling sessions and coordinate with the team.
* Maintain accurate lead details, call dispositions, and follow\-up records in the CRM/Google Sheets.
* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly calling and admission conversion targets.
* Build positive relationships with prospective students and ensure a professional counselling experience.

Requirements

* Excellent verbal communication and convincing skills.
* Fluency in English and Kannada. Hindi or other regional languages will be an advantage.
* Strong follow\-up skills and a target\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to handle objections and engage prospective students confidently.
* Freshers with good communication skills are welcome to apply.
* Prior experience in telecalling, telesales, education counselling, or inside sales will be an added advantage.

Salary \& Benefits

* Salary up to ₹18,000 per month, based on experience and skills.
* Attractive performance\-based incentives.
* Sales and admissions training.
* Career growth opportunities in the education industry.
* Supportive and performance\-driven work environment.

Working Schedule

* Full\-time, work from office.
* 6 days a week.
* Day shift.

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is ideal for freshers and experienced telecallers who are confident communicators, enjoy interacting with students, and want to build a career in sales and education admissions.

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent

**Salary:** ₹12,000 – ₹18,000 per month \+ Performance Incentives

**Experience:** Fresher or 1–3 years in telesales/telecalling (preferred)

**Work Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka (On\-site)

Apply Now!

Join HCMX Global Education and be part of a growing team helping students discover the right opportunities in higher education.

If you are confident, energetic, and passionate about sales, apply today!

Pay: ₹14,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: UKI Deal Support Specialist
description:
Location: Bengaluru
Other locations: Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Date: Sep 16, 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1743409
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Discipline**



Clients and Industries, Pursuits \& Commercial Excellence

  

**Role Type**

Deal Support Specialist \- Supervising Associate

  


**The opportunity**: EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) consists of various service delivery centres from which Client Service and Enablement Services teams operate to deliver strategic support to EY member firms. GDS spans all geographies, practices, services lines, sectors and competencies within EY to deliver integrated services that result in efficient and world\-class solutions. The position in discussion is with the P\&CE in EY GDS Clients and Industries Function. The GDS P\&CE serves as an extension to the onshore Deals team who are involved in the direct Bid Management Processes. The P\&CE supports the onshore teams on a number of opportunities, adding more value during the Deal process or the bid management cycle.



The Deal Support Specialist \- Supervising Associate provides support in the different phases of the Deal process. This role will support the Pursuit Strategist/Leader in all the stages of the Bid Management Process, involving in pre\-RFP, RFP response and post\-RFP phase. The range of activities include project management, research, review and analytical support for the onshore Deal team throughout the bid management cycle. This role will support in executing globally consistent strategy.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


**Strategic Pursuit and Opportunity Management:**


* Gather information through secondary research (both internal and external sources) and generate top\-notch deliverables such as company profiles, competitor insights, trend analysis, and other valuable assets to support pre and proposal development phases.
* Prepare and drive project management plan throughout the deal cycle by acting as a point of contact in managing the end\-to\-end process including but not limited to organising meetings, preparing meeting notes, finalising timelines and accountabilities as per deadlines.
* Owns the preparation of kick\-off documents, CV collation for team book, orals preparation and credentials pack. Support the development and coordination of proposal content and submission documents in line with pursuit requirements.
* Liaise with the broader team in development of client collaterals such as storyboards, placemats, proposals and internal presentations
* Establish and maintain clear and transparent communication and build strong stakeholders’ relationships by exhibiting professional etiquettes and adhering to agreed timelines and quality benchmarks
* Manage a repository of Regional, Market Segment or Service Line client\-facing collateral as appropriate
* Exhibit innovative thinking and flexible approach while managing complex and out\-of\-scope requests
* Own and maintain repository of client presentations, RFQ responses, marketing collateral, etc.
* Quality review of deliverables

title: Life Sciences – Domain Consultant
description:
About the role
  
As a Domain Strategist – Life Sciences, you will make an impact by crafting compelling, insight\-led proposals and bid responses for life sciences clients across the pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and diagnostics sectors. You will be a valued member of the Life Sciences Business Development team and work collaboratively with Sales and Solutioning teams to map client needs to solution capabilities and communicate clear business value to clients and key stakeholders.
  
In this role, you will
  
Act as a trusted advisor to Sales and Solutioning teams, articulating the business value of Cognizant Moment solutions within the Life Sciences industry and converting client business requirements into domain\-led solution options.
  
Drive domain content for proposals and bids, including win themes, solution storyboards, qualification responses, battle cards, and competitive one\-pagers that help sales quickly articulate differentiation.
  
Stay current on the Life Sciences ecosystem of product partners and Cognizant proprietary industry solutions and accelerators, mapping client use cases to strengthen proposal differentiation.
  
Curate reusable solution assets and reference architectures that accelerate proposal turnaround for Life Sciences opportunities.
  
Contribute to Life Sciences practice offerings, case studies, and thought leadership, mentor junior BD and pre\-sales associates, and provide market intelligence on competitor positioning and emerging client needs.
  
Work model
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Bangalore, Hyderabad, or Kolkata. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
What you need to have to be considered
  
Bachelor's degree in life sciences, engineering, or business; MBA or relevant master's preferred.
  
10\-15\+ years of experience in business development, pre\-sales, or consulting, with at least 5\+ years focused on the Life Sciences industry.
  
Understanding of commercial value chains, medical affairs, patient support programs, field\-force effectiveness, and omni\-channel engagement models.
  
Functional and strategic expertise in Life Sciences CRM platforms (e.g., Veeva Systems, Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud) and digital experience portals.
  
Proven experience supporting Life Sciences pursuits, client presentations, and solution demonstrations, with strong executive presence and excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
  
These will help you stand out
  
Strong domain understanding of the life sciences industry and its technology landscape.
  
Awareness of CX, CRM, and Digital Experience concepts relevant to pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and diagnostics clients.
  
Ability to engage consultatively across stakeholders, from sales teams to client executives.
  
Strong research synthesis and analysis skills to convert market and client insights into compelling proposal content.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.
